mechanism: Contrastive runtime evidence from same-crash and oracle-passing PoC variants of the current vulnerability
evidence_scope: ContraFixconstructs format-preservingsame-crashandoracle-passingPoC variants that still reach the same vulnerable execution region, then compares their executions to narrow a broad crash context to the failure boundary.
evidence_role: we proposeContraFix, an agentic AVR framework that turns a single exploit witness into boundary evidence for localization, patch generation, and experience reuse.
